summary: Short junction corner with a house at the kerb and No Stopping signs.
reasons: No Stopping and No Parking signs
Only 24 m, at a signalled junction

drivers.seclusion: A dwelling sits 1 m from the kerb at 14 m and others 8-13 m away; the corner is open to the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb wraps a corner beside a busy road with no clear shoulder; a van would sit in the junction mouth.
drivers.traffic: Picardy Street and Hawken Drive junction; busy and noisy.
drivers.convention: Signs show No Stopping Any Time, No Parking Any Time and No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm; a bus zone is nearby.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at 2 m from the kerb
Dwelling about 1 m from the kerb
sun_shade: Part shaded by hedge and trees on the west side.
